visible_observation: The composition is currently split into two disconnected zones: a heavy block of text on the left and a delicate, glowing geometric form on the right. The text is left-aligned and floats in the void, while the visual anchor (the bioluminescent shape) is isolated, creating a disjointed 'list' layout rather than a unified image.
critique: The layout lacks spatial tension and fails to integrate the text with the visual subject. The text block feels like a caption rather than part of the environment. The negative space between the title and the graphic is dead space; it does not contribute to the narrative of depth or pressure. The visual path is blocked because the eye cannot easily bridge the gap between the heavy typography and the subtle graphic.
revision: Shift the text block to the right side of the canvas to create a counter-weight to the graphic. Move the bioluminescent graphic to the left-center and scale it up significantly so it acts as a vertical pillar. Allow the text to overlap the edges of the graphic (creating depth) or align the text's left margin with the graphic's right edge to create a unified vertical axis.
protected_strength: The atmospheric gradient background and the specific color palette (deep navy, cyan, and red) effectively establish the deep-sea mood and must be preserved.
